question:
Architecture & Civil Engineering

An architect must position a skylight panel such that it is the mirror image of an emergency exit at $(7,1,3)$ in the plane $x+y-z=6$.

(a) Find the image coordinates of the exit in the plane.

(b) Write the vector equation of the line joining the exit and its image.

(c) Show that this line is perpendicular to the plane.

(d) Explain how this reflection helps maintain building symmetry.
explanation:
Normal vector of plane: $(1,1,-1)$.

Line through $P(7,1,3)$ along normal: $x=7+t$, $y=1+t$, $z=3-t$. Substituting into plane gives $t=1/3$. Foot $F=(22/3,4/3,8/3)$.

Since $F$ is midpoint of $PP'$, solving gives image $P'=(23/3,5/3,7/3)$.

Vector equation of joining line: $(7,1,3)+\lambda(2/3,2/3,-2/3)$. Direction vector proportional to plane normal, so the line is perpendicular to the plane.

Reflection across plane preserves symmetry in architectural layouts.

options.A:
(a) Image point is $\left(\frac{22}{3},\frac{4}{3},\frac{8}{3}\right)$
(b) Joining line is $\vec r=(7,1,3)+\lambda(1,1,-1)$
(c) The line lies in the plane
(d) It gives only the foot point, not symmetry
options.B:
(a) Image point is $\left(\frac{23}{3},\frac{5}{3},\frac{7}{3}\right)$
(b) Joining line is $\vec r=(7,1,3)+\lambda(1,-1,1)$
(c) The direction is not proportional to the normal
(d) It does not preserve reflection symmetry
options.C:
(a) Image point is $\left(\frac{23}{3},\frac{5}{3},\frac{7}{3}\right)$
(b) Joining line is $\vec r=(7,1,3)+\lambda\left(\frac{2}{3},\frac{2}{3},-\frac{2}{3}\right)$
(c) Its direction is proportional to plane normal $(1,1,-1)$, so it is perpendicular to the plane
(d) Reflection across the plane preserves architectural symmetry
options.D:
(a) Image point is $(7,1,3)$
(b) Joining line is undefined
(c) The point already lies on the plane
(d) No reflection is required
